Federal Parliament
House of Representatives, 2079
10th Session
Meeting Number - 60
Federal
Daily Agenda
Wednesday, Bhadra 18, 2082
1:00 PM
Letter from the Office of the President
The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter received from the Office of the President regarding the additional responsibilities.
1. Prime Minister and Council of Ministers' Office Letter
The Honorable Speaker will read out the letter received from the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers' Office regarding additional responsibilities.
2. Table of Messages
Secretary of the House of Representatives, Harkaraj Rai, will table the bill along with the message received from the House regarding the "Water Resources Bill, 2081".
3. Management Work
The Honorable Minister of Agriculture and Livestock Development, Ramnath Adhikari, will present a proposal for consideration of the "Nepal Veterinary Council (First Amendment) Bill, 2082".
4. The Honorable Home Minister, Ramesh Lekhak, will present a proposal for consideration of the amendments made by the National Assembly to the "Nepal Citizenship (Second Amendment) Bill, 2081".
4. Pad Prasad Pandey
Secretary-General
